name: Merystema
source:
After the ecological disaster, all the vegetation in the region died. Scientists deployed a mobile laboratory in the affected area to find a solution and bring life back to the wasteland.

...However, their development was stolen.

[Translated from [url=https://purple-mallow.itch.io/meristem]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
生态灾难发生后，该地区的植被全部死亡。科学家们在受影响地区部署了一个移动实验室，寻找解决方案，让荒地恢复生机。

……然而，他们的开发被窃取了。

[译自[url=https://purple-mallow.itch.io/meristem]itch.io[/url]]
